t: When you have decided and it is out of your hands
a: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
p: …wa ufawwiḍu amrī ila-llāh, inna-llāha baṣīrun bi-l-ʿibād.
m: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
